units.source_text: 四人挤在极窄的帐子里，紧贴父亲躺着的我，翻身的时候不知不觉地把父亲挤到一个犄角上。

en.t: The four of us were squeezed inside the extremely narrow mosquito net, and as I lay pressed close against my father, I unknowingly pushed him into a corner when I turned over.

units.source_text: 我和我所看到的东西之间，隔着布满皱纹的白床单，

en.t: Between me and the things I could see lay a white bedsheet covered with wrinkles,

units.source_text: 我背后就是把身子曲成一团熟睡着的父亲，他的鼾声直接灌进了我的衣领口里。

en.t: and behind me was my father, curled up and fast asleep, his snoring pouring straight into the opening of my collar.
